row.title: A push from a worktree of the Actions checkout uses the run's own token, not the token in the URL
row.body: tenant-repos run 45669164019: ultrastable/base-rates was created by the platform route, then the push of its split failed with 'Permission denied to github-actions[bot]'. actions/checkout stores an http extraheader in the repository config and a worktree shares it, so it overrides the token in the push URL. The push now clears that header. The seed step was unaffected because it pushes from a fresh git init. Same run: second-tenant repository created and filled, front-door walk passed with 0 visitor steps, fullstack --live read 5 of 5 systems complete.
